scope: Research hidden compiler/CMake inputs and implement a bounded fail-closed policy for unrepresented ambient search and toolchain injection channels in the semantic-adapter qualification builder.

method.kind: Primary compiler/build-system documentation plus local builder self-tests

findings.documentedEffect: GCC_EXEC_PREFIX can change subprogram, header and library lookup; COMPILER_PATH changes subprogram lookup; LIBRARY_PATH changes linker lookup; CPATH and language-specific variables add headers.
findings.builderDisposition: rejected when non-empty in controlled builds

findings.documentedEffect: CPATH and language-specific variables add header roots; config files can inject target, include, link and code-generation options; --no-default-config disables default config files; CCC_OVERRIDE_OPTIONS edits driver arguments.
findings.builderDisposition: include and CCC override channels rejected; existing default-config control retained; platform deployment target and SDK content remain partial

findings.documentedEffect: CL prepends arguments, _CL_ appends arguments, INCLUDE changes headers, and LIB/LIBPATH change libraries; developer prompts set additional tool/platform variables.
findings.builderDisposition: CL/_CL_ and INCLUDE/LIB/LIBPATH rejected until content-bound Windows toolchain profile exists

findings.documentedEffect: CMAKE_PROJECT_INCLUDE hooks and CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE introduce external CMake input during project initialization; prefix/module paths change package/module resolution; toolchain files can select target and sysroot behavior.
findings.builderDisposition: CMake prefix/module/project-include/toolchain environment keys rejected; active parent-cache CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE and CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN rejected

boundToolBinaries: GCC-reported cc1plus, assembler, collect2, LTO wrapper, and external specs file when absolute paths are reported
implementation.toolBinaryRecheck: CMake/compiler around configure and reconfigure; configured tool binaries immediately before and after each generator build
implementation.compilerSubprogramEvidence: GNU-only best-effort follow-up in compiler-dependency-closure-slice-2026-10-16.json; unresolved bare names remain unbound and do not promote the compile contract.

nextGate: Complete compiler runtime/resource/config closure, recursively account for external GCC specs includes, bind SDK/sysroot and actual link inputs, and qualify native MSVC/GNU profiles. Do not set implicitConfiguration=pass or issue paired receipts before every effective input in the supported profile is checked.
